title: Healing + Support = ?
paragraphs: “Somehow, I’m getting used to Motoyasu-san’s pace… Should we just give up?”
“…Yeah. It looks like the facade that pre-loop Naofumi put on is starting to peel away. He’s probably searching for the Filolial that Naofumi was supposed to raise in the future.”
“Exactly! I am dedicating myself day and night to meeting Filo-tan, Father’s beloved daughter!”
However, this time, I’m not going to buy Filo-tan. That’s right! I’m getting Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan!
“To quickly level up Father and the others, I will enlist the help of the Filolials!”
“Ah, while the Holy Heroes repel each other, their companions do not. So you’re planning to power level.”
“It’s a method that ruins the thrill of adventure, but given the situation, we don’t have much choice.”
“It’s necessary for raising Naofumi, after all.”
Ren and Itsuki glance toward Father. Their expressions are friendly.
“Then what should I do?”
“Eclair-san should…”
“For now, why not just stay with Naofumi until Motoyasu finishes raising his Filolial?”
“Oh? Not with Ren?”
“Why would I have to be with her?”
“Because in the future, I recall you and Éclair being together.”
Ren and Éclair exchange looks. Then, they both tilt their heads in confusion.
“According to the rumors among the Filolials, Ren is supposedly fond of Éclair. Was that just a misunderstanding?”
“Wait, what? Ren’s future lover!?”
Father eagerly jumps into the conversation. On the other hand, Ren narrows his eyes as he looks at Éclair. Does he dislike the idea?
“Why would I ever be in a romantic relationship with Amaki-dono?”
“I don’t know the details. But by the time I visited the territory managed by Father, you two were already in that kind of relationship.”
From what I saw, Ren was completely under Éclair’s thumb. But he didn’t seem to mind it too much—he was earnestly following Éclair’s commands.
“I’m sure there was a lot that led up to it.”
“That’s a convenient way to put it. If Motoyasu-kun’s story is true, why don’t you just go along with it like in the pre-loop timeline?”
“Not a chance.”
Ren flatly rejects the idea with a look of disgust.
“I appreciate the thought, but I don’t have time to be distracted by romance. Even if it were true, people must have just misinterpreted the situation.”
“I agree.”
How strange. Oh well, there’s no point dwelling on it. This must be one of the many changes brought by the loops.
“Well then, in this situation, it makes the most sense for Eclair to accompany Iwatani-dono, the Shield Hero.”
“Yeah, that makes sense. Eclair-san seems really serious—romance is probably the last thing on her mind.”
“Hearing that annoys me a little, but I can’t exactly deny it.”
Things are getting lively. For now, it’s time to grind levels, but this also marks the beginning of a new adventure!
“Siltvelt… Based on my game knowledge, this is a region we’re not supposed to be able to visit.”
“Same here.”
“This isn’t a game—it’s reality.”
At Father’s words, both Ren and Itsuki nod in agreement.
“Relying on game knowledge to search for monsters could be dangerous.”
“Indeed. And enemies aren’t limited to just monsters. There are also things like the slave hunts that Eclair experienced. Since we’re humans, we might be at risk.”
“Hahaha! Until the Filolials grow up, how about we all just rest at the inn?”
“Hiding away like that doesn’t sound like a good idea…”
“Then Eclair should go leveling with Motoyasu. The two of them together should be relatively safe, so that works, right?”
Oh? Father nods in response to Ren’s suggestion.
“Good idea. If buying a Filolial won’t take too long, let’s have Éclair level up while we wait for the eggs to hatch.”
“I’ve already undergone a class upgrade and have some combat experience, but…”
“Class upgrade?”
At this point, Father doesn’t seem to have much knowledge about it. I’ll have to explain everything in detail later.
“By the way, Ren, Itsuki.”
“What?”
“Yes?”
“Are you aware that there’s a hidden secret to how the Heroes’ weapons can be strengthened?”
At my question, Ren and Itsuki think deeply before nodding. This time around, they’re easy to talk to—makes things a lot smoother.
“I’ve only considered it as a possibility, but… are you saying there’s a method different from the one I know?”
“If Motoyasu-san’s weapon isn’t some special exception, then we have to assume there is another way, right?”
“In the future, they said it was infused with the power of NPCs.”
“It was strong enough that I wouldn’t be surprised if that were true.”
“Yeah.”
“Unfortunately, that’s not the case. Ren, Itsuki, and I… We all blindly believed in the enhancement methods we chose, only to hit a wall and regret it later.”
Ren and Itsuki gulp audibly.
“What about me?”
“You’re the one who broke through that wall, Father. Without your words, I probably would have remained weak.”
“Huh…? So what’s the secret?”
“It’s quite complicated. I can explain it now, but it’d be better to sit down and talk about it properly.”
“Is it that long?”
“Throughout all the loops, neither Ren nor Itsuki has ever managed to do it even once. The only ones who could were those who, like me, experienced a major failure in our first world.”
“A major failure… In a way, I guess I’ve been through something similar.”
“That’s true. Motoyasu-san, I understand now. No matter what it is, if something like that is possible, I’ll put my full trust in it.”
“Alright, let’s first decide on an inn for tonight and make sure we don’t cause any unnecessary trouble.”
“Worst case scenario, can’t Father just raise his shield and declare himself the Shield Hero?”
“That… sounds incredibly dangerous,” Father responded in his usual, unique rhythm.
What kind of act is this? I don’t quite understand.
“If we tried that, we’d probably be executed—for religious reasons.”
“Yeah, I have no interest in repeating what happened in that country.”
Now that I think about it, last time we came to Siltvelt, Keel was with us. There’s a huge difference between coming here as a group of only humans and bringing along demi-humans.

After that, we decided on an inn while also picking out a suitable weapon for Éclair. Ren and Itsuki, to be extra cautious, chose to stay at the inn. As for Éclair, she said she’d rest near the entrance, leaning against a chair—just in case.
“Before we set out, let’s heal Éclair’s wounds.”

Even though she’s now wearing some cheap armor, just a while ago, her outfit made her look barely better than a slave. She still has lingering wounds. I focus my mind and cast healing magic on Éclair.
Before my eyes, her wounds—both fresh and old scars—begin to heal rapidly. Oh? Ren and Itsuki are watching with interest.
“Hmm, I feel much better. Kitamura-dono, you are quite the skilled magic user.”
Éclair says this as she touches the now-healed areas. Hearing that makes me a little embarrassed. Since I learned this magic from Father, I can’t help but feel proud.
“Wow… So this is what healing magic looks like in action. That’s kind of amazing.”
“My healing magic is nothing compared to Father’s.”
“I’m sure that’s true, but I can’t even use magic yet.”
“A defensive role that also focuses on healing and support… Rather than just a tank, he’s more of a hybrid support role… A cleric, huh?”
“That’s right. In the future, maybe we were secretly looking down on Naofumi-san, but if you think of him as a support role, it changes the perspective.”
“You’re wrong. When it comes to defense, no one surpasses Father. If he were fully strengthened, he could withstand even my strongest attacks.”
“He could survive that?! The attack that wiped out everything and burned down an entire building?!”
If it’s Father, it’s no problem. My attacks would probably sound like kicking a tin can to him.
“Ren, let’s not bring that up. I don’t want to remember it.”
“Y-Yeah. I might have nightmares.”
“Ugh… Now I’m worried I won’t be able to sleep tonight.”
For some reason, Father and the others seem to lose their energy when certain topics come up. Is there something specific that bothers them?
“If you let it get to you, you won’t survive!”
“I know, but… dreams alone won’t keep me going.”
“Yeah… I need to get stronger.”
“In more ways than one.”
“But looking at Motoyasu-kun, it feels like the stronger he gets, the more important things he loses.”
Ren and Itsuki make slightly complicated expressions at those words. This time, Father’s group seems to be getting along well. It makes all the effort worth it.
“Alright, we’ll be off now. Wait for us, okay?”
“Even if we leave you behind, you’d catch up, right, Motoyasu-kun?”
“Yeah, he’d probably chase us to the ends of the earth.”
“There’s no escaping him. This must be how protagonists feel when they’re guarded by an assassin from the underworld.”
“Oh, I get it. That’s a good analogy.”
“Way too accurate. But… at least he’s on our side.”

Father and the others start chatting excitedly. Éclair, meanwhile, watches them in silence, keeping an eye on the hallway with a serious expression. I wave my hand and use Portal to head off and buy Yuki-chan and the others.
